name: book-of-engineering
description: Engineering practice skills for the grimoire: test-driven development and architecture decision records.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering practice skills: TDD and architecture decision records
interface.longDescription: Book of Engineering is the grimoire's book of software engineering practice. The tdd skill runs the red-green-refactor loop at agreed seams and keeps every test honest. The adr skill decides whether a decision deserves a record, finds the repository's decision log, and writes one immutable MADR-style record with a Y-statement.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature test-first with TDD.
Record the decision we just made as an ADR.
